free_design.Place: a quiet indoor swimming pool before opening time, pale turquoise water and coiled lane ropes
free_design.Activity: kneeling on the dry pool edge to free a tangled lane-rope float, her swimdress overskirt caught and gathered upward against her thigh by the rope as she works, revealing more upper thigh while the opaque swim bottoms remain securely in place
free_design.Pose: kneeling with one knee raised, right hand lifting the lane rope and left hand untangling the float, looking down with a small patient smile
free_design.Framing: three-quarter view from head to lower shins, camera slightly above seated eye level, both hands and the caught fabric visible, balanced natural perspective
free_design.Outfit: a fully lined sea-green two-piece swimdress with a deep sweetheart swim top and broad crossed shoulder bands, high-waisted swim briefs under a short asymmetric scalloped overskirt attached by a soft side knot; the overskirt is gathered by the rope, all intimate areas securely covered
